jobs.title: Cloud & MLOps Engineer - Financial Services
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Our AI team, based in Belgium, supports clients across various business sectors, with a focus on Financial Services—including banking, capital markets, insurance, wealth and asset management—helping them embrace AI at scale and achieve tangible results while transforming their approach to the future.

We are currently looking for a talented and motivated Cloud & MLOps Engineer to join our team.

Your Key Responsibilities

Build and operate secure, scalable ML/LLM platforms on CLoud, automating environments, packaging, testing and deployments via CI/CD (Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions).
Implement end‑to‑end MLOps/LLMOps: data and model versioning (MLflow/DVC), automated training/inference pipelines, evaluation, and model governance (registries, approvals, rollbacks).
Engineer robust RAG pipelines: data ingestion, chunking, embeddings, indexing, caching and retrieval optimization for vector stores (Azure AI Search/Redis/pgvector).
Harden runtime infrastructure (AKS/ACI) with IaC (Terraform/Bicep), secrets management (Key Vault), RBAC, network security and cost/usage monitoring.
Set up observability across app/data/model layers (Application Insights, Prometheus/Grafana), implement SLOs, alerting, incident response and on‑call runbooks.
Collaborate with architects, engineers and security to enforce SDLC controls, perform performance tuning and capacity planning, and document operations.
API Development & Backend Integration: Build and secure APIs for integration with core systems; develop event-driven microservices; support front-end integration.
Security & Monitoring: Enforce robust security (OAuth2, Zero Trust, API rate limiting); establish monitoring dashboards for chatbot performance and infrastructure reliability.

Skills And Attributes For Success

4–8 years of experience in DevOps/MLOps or platform engineering, preferably in Financial Services.
Hands‑on with Cloud Technologies (AKS, ACR, App Service/Functions, Storage, Key Vault), Python, Bash, containers and Kubernetes.
Experience with Azure ML and/or Databricks for ML lifecycle; familiarity with Transformers, PyTorch and inference optimization.
Proficiency with CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions), testing automation and artifact management.
Experience with Backend & API: .NET Core, GraphQL, FastAPI, Node.js. as well as front end (React, JavaScript…)
Experience with vector databases and LLM toolchains (LangChain, Semantic Kernel).
Proven experience in Infrastructure Engineering: ARM/Bicep, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, general cloud security & IAM, Kubernetes, networking.
Fluent in Dutch or French and a business proficiency in English.

Can we dream for more?

Certifications: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, CKA/CKAD, Azure AI Engineer.
Policy‑as‑code and compliance tooling (OPA/Gatekeeper, Azure Policy), and DORA‑aligned resilience practices.
Hands‑on experience operating platforms in highly regulated FS environments.
Strong Azure infra engineering background; hybrid cloud; cloud migration.
Experience with identity/security projects; general security knowledge; cloud networking.

What We Offer You

You will be part of a leading global professional services firm.
You will be part of the EY family where everyone is willing to offer support and senior management is very accessible.
You will join a dynamic and growing team with a great mix of young and experienced professionals focusing on financial services.
You will get extensive trainings on technical matters, as well as soft skills and project management, and you will have access to new technologies and innovative equipment.
We are proud of our flexible working arrangements, and we will support you to build a successful career and deliver excellent client service, without sacrificing your personal priorities.
While our client-facing profession might require part-time working at client site and business traveling at times, we are committed to helping you achieve a lifestyle balance.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.description:
Cargill is committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. Sitting at the heart of the supply chain, we partner with farmers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living.

Our 155,000 team members innovate with purpose, providing customers with life’s essentials so businesses can grow, communities prosper, and consumers live well. With over 160 years of experience as a family company, we look ahead while remaining true to our values. We put people first. We reach higher. We do the right thing—today and for generations to come.

Job Purpose and Impact

The Senior Software Engineer - Agriculture & Trading will design and develop new and existing digital solutions for the organization's digital portfolio. In this role, you will discover and deliver solutions to complex and varied problems to enable the company's digital future. You will bring order to ambiguous scenarios and apply in depth and broad knowledge of architectural, engineering and security practices to ensure your solutions are scalable, resilient and robust and will share knowledge on modern practices and technologies to the shared engineering community.

Key Accountabilities

Demonstrate accountability by ensuring timely and high-quality project delivery.
Be result driven, consistently achieving measurable outcomes and meeting goals.
Act as a team player, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Exhibit a can-do mentality, tackling challenges with a proactive and positive approach.
Apply software engineering patterns and principles to design, develop, test, integrate, maintain, troubleshoot and document complex and varied software solutions and incorporate security practices in newly developed and maintained applications.
Participate in peer code review sessions to review code, coach peers and ensure code quality.
Take the lead in the assigned agile team to adopt agile philosophies, facilitate agile ceremonies and identify continuous improvement opportunities.
Incorporate the company's engineering and development best practices within the full software development lifecycle including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, building processes, testing and security principles, to deliver high quality code rapidly.
Collaborate to lead demonstration and continuous feedback sessions to improve development and help drive the long term vision.
Participate in the engineering community by maintaining and sharing relevant technical approaches and modern skills.
Independently handle complex issues with minimal supervision, while escalating only the most complex issues to appropriate staff.
Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience
Confirmed experience automating pipelines for continuous integration, testing, delivery and security.
Confirmed experience architecting applications, databases, services or integrations.
Extensive experience with .NET Framework and .NET Core.
Familiarity with front-end technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.js.
Experience with DevOps practices and tools such as Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
Knowledge of SQL Server and / or PostgreSQL for database design and management.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration and management.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Minimum of 5 years of related work experience in software development using .NET technologies.

Preferred Qualification

Understanding of microservices architecture and deployment strategies using Kubernetes.
Experience in breaking up monolithic applications into microservices.
Proficiency in Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) for building desktop applications.
Experience in integrating and utilizing AI models (e.g. in software solutions).
Understanding of ethical considerations and best practices in AI development.

Our Offer

We provide a fast paced stimulating international environment, which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents. We also offer competitive salary and benefits combined with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the largest and most solid private companies in the world.

Interested? Then make sure to send us your CV and cover letter in English today:

Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/cargill

jobs.description:
(Falls LinkedIn keine Bewerbungen akzeptiert, bitte hier bewerben: https://www.letsboot.ch/jobs/agentic-tech-org-enablement)

Short Facts: CHF 120'000-135'000 Brutto/100%/Jahr inklusive Bonus, 60-80%, Home Office, 5 Wochen Ferien, Kurse und Sparring Sessions zu AI Coding und Agenten vor Ort unterrichten & entwickeln, Golden Paths, Skills, MCP-Server und Plugins bauen, Trainings-Plattform weiterentwickeln, Konferenzen & Talks & Zertifikate gewünscht und gefördert, Austausch mit & Unterstützung von Letsboot Trainer*innen, Neue Kursthemen vorschlagen und Aufbauen.

(Fliessend Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift sind eine zwingende Voraussetzung für diese Stelle.)

Beschreibung des Unternehmens

Letsboot.ch ist ein Schulungsanbieter, der praxisorientierte Kurse für Software- und System-Engineers anbietet. Unsere Kurse werden von erfahrenen Expertinnen und Experten mit bewährtem Schulungsmaterial konzipiert und durchgeführt. Wir bieten primär "In-House" Schulungen für Kunden vor Ort und sekundär öffentliche Schulungen sowie zugeschnittene Sparring Sessions an. Eines der Kernmerkmale von letsboot.ch ist eine umfangreiche und sehr leistungsfähige Laborumgebung auf einer eigenen Private-Cloud, die Dreh- und Angelpunkt für alle Kursdurchführungen ist und eine mächtige "Labmachine" Lösung beinhaltet. Teilnehmende können während aber auch nach dem Kurs umfangreiche Umgebungen innert kürzester Zeit starten und "Hands-On" lernen.

Empower people to Master Agentic AI

Dies ist eine 60-80%ige Rolle im Kernteam als Trainer:in, Sparring Partner und Builder. Du hilfst Menschen, agentisch zu arbeiten: mit AI und Agenten im ganzen SDLC, von Product Management und Requirements Engineering über Architektur und Code bis zu Tests und Betrieb.

Unterrichten: praxisnahe Kurse auf Deutsch und Englisch, mit echten Aufgaben statt Folien.

Sparring: mit Kundenteams an deren Requirements, Code und Workflows arbeiten.

Bauen: Golden Paths, Blueprints, Skills, MCP-Server, Plugins, Labs und Übungen.

Golden Paths und Blueprints sind erprobte Wege von einer Aufgabe zu einem brauchbaren Ergebnis: gutes Requirement, passender Kontext, geeignete Tools, überprüfbare Qualitätskriterien. Teilnehmende sollen verstehen, warum ein Ansatz funktioniert und wo seine Grenzen liegen.

Agentic (Software Engineering | Product | Tech-Leadership | Tech-aligned .*)

Kern ist der Agentic SDLC: Product Discovery, Requirements, Architektur, Implementierung, Tests, Deployment, Betrieb. Dazu Tech Management, Product & Requirements Engineering, Platform und Workflow Engineering.

Deine Teilnehmenden sind Software Engineers, Product Owners, Requirements Engineers, Scrum Masters, Platform Engineers, UX/UI, People Manager technischer Teams, technische Leads und CTOs. Tech-aligned heisst: alle, die mit dem SDLC zu tun haben - Jira-Tickets, Spezifikationen, Designs, Releases -, ob hands-on im Code oder als Person, die zehn Tech-Teams führt.

Unsere Kunden sind mehrheitlich grosse Schweizer Unternehmen aus Banking, Versicherung, Retail, Industrie und Verwaltung. Kursthemen reichen von Agentic Software Engineering über Agentic Requirements & Product Engineering bis Agentic Tech Management. Die Flughöhe reicht vom einzelnen Prompt bis zum eigenen Agent Harness.

Unser Büro befindet sich in Basel, Kurse sind jeweils vor Ort bei Kunden in der ganzen Schweiz und die Stelle bietet eine hohe Flexibilität für Home-Office. Der Bruttojahreslohn beträgt CHF 120'000-135'000 bei 100%, inklusive Bonus (effektiver Betrag hängt vom Pensum ab).

Anforderungen

Engineering in einer grösseren Firma: du kennst Scrum oder SAFe, Product Owner, Architekturvorgaben, Security und Compliance aus eigener Erfahrung

Mehrjährige Software Engineering-Praxis: Backend und Frontend, Code, APIs, Daten, Tests, Architekturentscheidungen

DevOps-Basis-Kenntnisse: Pipelines, Deployment und Betrieb sind dir vertraut, du musst dort nicht Spezialist sein

Requirements und Workflow Engineering: Ziele in klare Aufgaben und überprüfbare Akzeptanzkriterien übersetzen

Tägliche Praxis mit AI und Agenten (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, MCP), inklusive Prüfung der Ergebnisse - du zeigst uns live, wie du arbeitest

Freude am Vermitteln und sicheres Auftreten vor Gruppen, Tempo und Tiefe passend zu den Teilnehmenden

Fähigkeit, klare Diagramme zu erstellen, um komplexe Themen zu erklären (z.Bsp. mit draw.io oder mermaid)

Bereitschaft, sich in das Letsboot.ch Kurs-Framework einzuarbeiten und dieses schrittweise zu verbessern

Hohe Motivation, Zertifikate wie etwa die Anthropic Claude Zertifizierungen innert kurzer Zeit nach Stellenantritt zu absolvieren

Interesse und Bereitschaft, zu Konferenzen zu reisen und Vorträge zu halten

Fliessend in Deutsch und Englisch, um komplexe Themen in beiden Sprachen vermitteln zu können

A Little Bit About Our Engineering Culture

Shorten Feedback Loops: we optimize for flow of value in small batches so that we can learn faster and minimize waste. This applies to how we build systems, communicate with each other, etc

Quality enables Speed: we adhere to XP, Lean, and Continuous Delivery practices to deliver value with the highest quality/security in a sustainable way

Product-minded Engineers: we all have a good understanding of our business & customer problems to minimize costly hand-overs and ensure we solve problems more effectively, and faster

Alongside your cross-functional team (engineering, product, data), participate in continuous discovery of your customer/business needs/desires/problems to drive desired outcomes.

Understand scalability & complexity of your services and own & innovate the entire SDLC
